# MonStim Analyzer vX.Y.Z

> **Windows beta:** This release is a packaged Windows application. Download only from this official release. Binaries are not code-signed; verify `SHA256SUMS.txt` before running an artifact.

## Highlights

- 

## Install or update

1. Download and extract the full Windows archive.
2. Verify the archive checksum against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
3. Keep all extracted files together and launch MonStim Analyzer.
4. Back up managed experiment data before replacing an existing installation.

## Compatibility and known limitations

- Direct import: MonStim V3D/V3H CSV exports.
- Other data sources require an official importer add-on.
- Packaged binary: Windows only.

## Citation and support

If MonStim contributes to academic work, please use the repository citation entry or **Help > Copy Citation**. Include the version, active profile, error report, and non-identifiable reproduction steps in support requests.
